nodes.source: hand: glass door seen in the panoramas; the wall plan records no opening there
nodes.label: the south glass door from the west entrance hall
nodes.note: Single glass door in a black frame set in a stone arch on the west side of the arcade: long pull bar, powered operator on the header, and a steel post with a wheelchair push button beside it; a red EXIT sign hangs over the arcade at this door. Through the glass: a stone entrance hall with a beamed ceiling, wall lanterns, a directory board and walk-off mats, and at its far end an arched doorway with glazed doors and daylight, about 13 m from the arcade (two sight lines: sweep 0f2a2 at heading 198 and sweep pr6uq at heading 164). The hall and that outside door are not scanned. Marked as the main entrance because of the hall, the directory and the powered door; picking this door over the north one, 3 m away into the same hall, is a judgment. Not seen: whether it locks after hours, and whether there are steps outside. Width is an estimate from the panorama.

approach.note: the way from the street is not in the scan: across the paved forecourt (read off the aerial) and through the west entrance hall (seen through the glass). The link from the staging spot carries the distance

scope: Levels 100 and 200 around the central atrium only (the scan calls them Floor 2 and Floor 3): the stone arcade inside the west entrance, the atrium floor, the ring corridors on both levels, the open atrium stair between them and Room 217. Not scanned: the west entrance hall and its outside door, Campus Level A below the atrium (seen from the railings; the scan's Floor 1), Level 300 above, the two enclosed stairwells, the elevator car, the office suites, and the wings that the corridors run on into at all four corners of both levels. Floor numbers are from signs: the jambs of elevator PE1 read 1 and 2, the directory beside it lists Level 300, Level 200, Level 100 and Campus Level A, and room signs read 118 to 120 on the lower level and 200 and 217 to 219 on the upper.
